title: Primary stalk annihilator
statement: Under the finite ell-primary stalk hypotheses, some power of ell annihilates the identity of M.

proof.text: Apply Mathlib isPGroup_iff_exists_pow_pow_eq_one to the finite multiplicative version of the stalk. Applying Multiplicative.toAdd yields an exponent e with ell^e times every stalk element equal to zero. This includes the trivial stalk and does not need primality beyond the unchanged statement hypotheses.

The proved sheafFiber_map_smul lemma in WeilConjectures.CategoryTheory.Sites.Point.Linear identifies the image of ell^e times the identity with ell^e times the identity of the stalk. Extensionality of AddCommGrpCat morphisms and the preceding elementwise equality show that this image equals the image of zero.

Spec of a field is a singleton, so the displayed geometric point covers it. Apply the proved isConservativeFamilyOfPoints_ulift_pointSmallEtale_of_iUnion_range_eq_univ and jointlyFaithful to this PUnit-indexed covering family. Transfer the equality of maps to its universe-lifted stalk via uliftSheafFiberIso naturality and cancel its isomorphism component. Joint faithfulness gives ell^e times the identity of M equal to zero.

theorem exists_primary_annihilator
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {C : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsConnectedCurve f] [Smooth f] [IsAffine C] [IsIntegral C]
    (M : Sheaf (Spec C.functionField).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (ℓ : ℕ) (hℓ : ℓ.Prime)
    (hfinite : Finite (((Scheme.pointSmallEtale
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap C.functionField (AlgebraicClosure C.functionField))))).sheafFiber
          (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj M))
    (hprimary : IsPGroup ℓ (Multiplicative (((Scheme.pointSmallEtale
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap C.functionField (AlgebraicClosure C.functionField))))).sheafFiber
          (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj M))) :
    ∃ (e : ℕ), (ℓ ^ e) • 𝟙 M = 0
